result.summary: Found several visual issues: a loading spinner covering the main popular restaurant image, truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off filter chip on the right.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, obscuring the food photo and looking like a stuck or broken load state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or use a subtler skeleton/placeholder that does not cover the center of the content.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full name visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, shrink font slightly, or ensure consistent card width/padding so the full restaurant name fits.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partially cut-off pill on the far right edge beyond 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the horizontal scroll container or fade the edge so the cutoff looks intentional rather than clipped.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the fastest cards uses a very light gray that may have weak contrast on white.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to improve readability while keeping hierarchy.
